'''Quorian Dorjis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was once sent on a mission to infiltrate the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] which he failed and eventually was captured.<ref name="Jailbreak" />
Through drugs and [[Sith sorcery/Legends|sorcery]], [[Sith Inquisitor|Inquisitor]] [[Urinth]], managed to manipulate his mind so he would think that he had gathered important information on Sith plans. One [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolyte]] was then assigned to gain his trust and set him free discretely, so he would return to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with the false information without questioning.<ref name="Jailbreak" />
